text.en:
To carry into effect the provisions of Commonwealth Act Numbered Thirty-two, the sum of
seventy-five thousand pesos is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the Philippine Treasury not otherwise
appropriated, to be at the disposal of the Director of Lands under the direction of the Secretary of Agriculture
and Commerce, to defray the expenses of the subdivision of all the lands acquired by the Government under
the provisions of Act Numbered Eleven hundred and twenty, known as the Friar Lands Act, as amended, and
still undisposed of.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, October 29, 1936.
